functions.name: core_watchdog_start
functions.brief: Start the independent watchdog with a timeout in milliseconds. Selects the best prescaler/reload combination automatically. Common values: 1000, 2000, 5000, 10000 (max ~28000). WARNING: Once started, the IWDG cannot be stopped.

functions.name: core_watchdog_feed
functions.brief: Feed the watchdog. Must be called before the timeout expires.

functions.name: core_watchdog_caused_reset
functions.brief: Check if the last reset was caused by the watchdog.

functions.name: core_watchdog_clear_flags
functions.brief: Clear all reset flags (call after checking cause).
